name: Adventures in the Light & Dark
source: Theo's world gets increasingly surreal after befriending a band of misfits on a scrapyard island. Follow Theo into the twisted world of Phaser Reach, the Greatest Space Station North of the Harbor.
translation: 在废品岛上与一群格格不入的人成为朋友后，西奥的世界变得越来越超现实。跟随Theo进入Phaser Reach的扭曲世界，Phaser Reach是港口以北最大的空间站。
